pkgmetadata.longdescription: Webull Desktop is the trading terminal of Webull Securities. Upstream ships a Debian .deb only; this ebuild repacks it for Gentoo. Two things need fixing for a non-Debian system: the binaries carry a hardcoded RUNPATH of /usr/local/WebullDesktop (rewritten to /opt with patchelf), and they link against libcurl-gnutls.so.4, a Debian-specific SONAME (bridged to Gentoo's libcurl.so.4 with a symlink inside the install dir).
